description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff functionalities, including relative paths, diff options, and external diff command integration.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Checks the diff output for a specific file with given parameters, comparing actual and expected output.

methods.name: check_numstat
methods.description: Checks the diff --numstat output for a specific file and verifies it matches expected lines.

methods.name: check_stat
methods.description: Checks the diff --stat output summarizing changes for a specific file.

methods.name: check_raw
methods.description: Checks the raw diff output for a specific file.

methods.name: check_diff_relative_option
methods.description: Tests diff output with specific --relative options configured.

methods.name: check_diff_no_relative_option
methods.description: Tests diff output with --relative options explicitly disabled.
